_doc: Body Backstage (the human-body channel): 'live scan', the season 1 reboot look the owner approved on 3 Nov 2026 (films/channels/body/looktest). The body is filmed like a premium medical-visualisation title: photoreal wet tissue under a film light rig on an abyss teal-black ground, and the channel's chartreuse kept as the scan instrument (scan line, slice edges, reticles, readouts). Read by kits/cinema/film/page.mjs and kits/cinema/sci/contrast.py. Sizes are px at 1080×1920; the roles carry them in vmin (px / 10.8). Not Lumevina (black/rose/gold, glass bells), not Skin Sense (violet + cyan), not Los Güeros, not Claude coral.
name: Body Backstage
promise: What your body is doing right now, while you watch.

scene._doc: 3D materials and lights only: never text, never CSS. Wet, photoreal tissue under a warm key, a cool mint-white rim and a dark teal fill; only signal and blood bloom.
scene.lights: hemisphere #9FD8C8 / #08100F at 0.35; warm key #FFF0E2 from the top right; mint-white rim #DFF8EE from behind; a soft warm fill from below the lens

highlight._doc: The word being spoken turns chartreuse on the plate; words still to come are text-2, words said are text.

type._doc: One family, two widths. Titles and big numbers: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next 800 (tight tracking); captions 700; labels 600. The instrument (series line, badges, readouts, scale pills, counters' units): Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, tracked uppercase. Fraunces retired with the old look (3 Nov). Both ship unmodified (Atkinson reserves its names).

sizes._doc: px at 1080×1920. Captions: at most 2 lines of at most 24 characters (kits/cinema/script pages them with max_chars = 24); the size is the largest whole px at which the widest of the 142 rows of all three episode-1 scripts (paged at 24 characters) fits the plate's maximum width, 0.72 × W = 778 px, without hud.js shrinking it. Measured in Chromium with this face on 2026-10-22: it fits up to 55.3 px; at 55 px the widest row ('balls down the same way.') makes a 772 px plate. The studio plan's 56–72 px was set for 32-character lines. Labels: the pill is at least 0.035 × H = 67 px tall.

labels._doc: Every label names its part in words; the colour goes on the dot (or ring) and the pill border, so colour is never the only cue. The pill is opaque surface (label-bg), so deoxy keeps its 3.25:1 over any frame (at 94% it fell to 2.71:1 over a white bloom; contrast.py). O₂ (white) and immune (cream) sit ΔE 7.9 apart, so O₂ has a solid ring and immune a dashed one.

deoxy.use: oxygen-poor blood; the dot gets a white ring (3.25:1 on surface on its own)

contrast._doc: What contrast.py checks besides the automatic pairs (text, captions, labels, badges, scrim). grounds: the flat colours text can sit on. behind: what the caption plate, label pills and badges can sit over (worst case first).

pairs.note: dark text on a chartreuse button or chip
the whoa number, on the plain ground
the whoa number on a card
pulse is never text on the glow (about 4.5:1 there); lines only
the pulse line on the ground
the pulse line over the glow

motif.signature_shape: The scan: one chartreuse phosphor line that sweeps the frame on a beat and switches what it passes into scan view (dark glass cores, glowing edges, iso-depth slices, blood running hot). The same chartreuse draws slice edges where the scan cuts tissue open, the reticles that lock on to moving cells, and the readouts.
motif.keep_out: The series line and the title own a clear zone (top left, from the safe top to below the title): a dark scrim sits behind them, and no label, counter, reticle or card is placed there while the title shows (owner, 3 Nov).
motif.iris: Scale changes go through the scan: a sweep that hands one scale to the next, plus a scale bar that re-measures.
motif.title_card: Atkinson Next 800 title (accent word in signal) over a scrim; 'BODY BACKSTAGE · NO. 0N' in tracked mono above it.
motif.end_card: 'Next, inside: …' in Atkinson Next 800, 'Body Backstage · No. 0N', and a 'Follow Body Backstage' chip.
